source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Ιανουάριος, Μαξίμη και Μακαρία οι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole body is one sentence and it gives no year, no city and no emperor, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`. Three names in one line, so three folders. Not the Januarius the corpus already keeps with a Greek row on 30 Αυγούστου, who is the presbyter of the company of bishop Felix: saint.gr prints the two as separate entries on two days, and the settled rule is that two entries on one calendar are two commemorations.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
